anya: bringing up gemma-lite-v2 (hub: gemma/gemma-lite-v2) on int4 showed a strange vocab shift when running long-context evals. tokens 100..200 drifted, outputs rephrased incorrectly.

carl: got logs?

anya: paste: ```diff
- input token id 502 -> 'bank'
+ input token id 503 -> 'bank'
``` looks like map shifted by +1 after tokenizer conversion step.

jia: did you run the conversion script with --preserve-offsets? sometimes the tokenizer preproc merges unseen bytes.

anya: yes, ran convert_vocab.py --keep-offsets, still see mismatch. repro on CPU native vs runtime compiled kernels.

morgan: could be rotary/headmap alignment. If head-dim mapping differs when we split heads for qwen->gemma export, kv cache indexing might shift.

carl: try forcing rotary_scale = 1.0 in runtime config and re-run short smoke

anya: did that — rotary_scale=1.0 reduces but doesn't eliminate drift. Also quantize int4 with per-channel vs per-tensor changes behavior.

deploy-bot: test-run #3310023456 started: tests/int4-vocab-smoke

jia: quick check: run this small script to diff tokenizer ids and embed matrix hash

```bash
python -c "import numpy as np, json; ids=json.load(open('ids.json')); print(np.array(ids).sum())"
```

morgan: can you dump first 512 kv cache token ids before and after conversion? I suspect an off-by-one when padding sentinels are remapped.

anya: uploading kv-dump to #eng-ml/artifacts (link)

carl: benchmark numbers? any quality regression metrics?

anya: on our summarization eval (100 docs): FP16 baseline ROUGE-L 28.4, int4 per-tensor gave 25.9, int4 per-channel 27.1. Token mapping fix improved per-channel to 27.9.

jia: interesting — so mapping caused ~0.8 ROUGE-L delta. that's in line with token aliasing affecting context windows.

morgan: action items: 1) add post-conversion id check that hashes embed matrix + tokenizer mapping 2) add rotary head-dim compatibility test 3) add int4 per-channel fallback in runtime when mapping mismatch detected.

anya: I'll open a PR with test and a minimal reproducer. assigning to @carl for runtime guard.

carl: ack. I'll instrument kv-cache index assertions and add a smoke in CI.

deploy-bot: test-run #3310023456 completed: 7/8 passed

anya: thanks all — keeping thread open until PR landed.
